about: Human romanisation pairs for this language (training/mlkb/langs/human.py, PairSource): each split a TSV of native word, romanisation, count. Train calibrates the tables and trains the transliterator, dev validates, test is held out. Read by the builder only; not shipped in the pack.
credit: Dakshina dataset v1.0, Google Research (Roark et al., 2020), CC BY-SA 4.0
missing: Extract it from the Dakshina tar (data/manifests/dakshina.json): ./data/fetch.sh --only dakshina && tar -xf data/raw/dakshina/dakshina_dataset_v1.0.tar -C data/raw/dakshina 'dakshina_dataset_v1.0/si/lexicons/*'
